comments.author: Twisted8ight
comments.body_html:
Man what a great mod! It’s such a simple thing really, but it changes the gameplay so much and for the better imo.

Had a fight with a bunch of boss scavs and I managed to run into a building and lock off certain doors so that I could fight from just one side. It felt so great managing to hold it down like that. I likely would have died if not for this mod, and maybe that’s op, but I really don’t care. 10/10 mod.

comments.author: BigJohn
comments.body_html: I would just like to report that there seems to be an issue with locking doors behind you that require a keycard. I have twice now locked a door on labs after using a keycard to get inside and the door will just no longer have the prompt to unlock/open the door at all. The door becomes completely unusable and tanks the entire raid.

comments.author: Jehree Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
I’m looking into a fix, in the meantime it looks like running the unlock_all_player_locked_doors console command (press ~) unlocks the door to the keycard rooms.

I tested the keycard doors themselves and they appear to work fine. Scanning my red keycard again opens the door as usual.

comments.author: Jehree Senior Moderator
comments.body_html: Fixed in v1.2.1.
